t: You're at West Ham Jewish Cemetery in Newham. The New Synagogue on Great St Helen's established it in 1856, and the Great Synagogue in Duke's Place soon joined it. It has been closed to new burials since 2002. Several notable people lie here. Sir David Salomons, a leader in the fight for Jewish emancipation, was the first Jewish Sheriff and Lord Mayor of London. His relative Philip Salomons was a financier and Jewish leader. Also buried here is Haim Wasserzug, a cantor and composer who pioneered choral arrangements in synagogue services.
